<description>
Significantly improves loadtxoutset performance via a number of changes:

 * parallel threads for decoding, hashing, serializing and writing to leveldb
 * no fsync() gating writes
 * no redundant loading into CoinsView

Also adds a subcommand to bitcoin-util for getting a snapshot's hash_serialized_3, muhash, coin count and total amount values without importing to leveldb first.

On my systems, performance ends up bottlenecked by leveldb CPU usage.
</description>
